## Purpose
The SQLAlchemy tables for knowledge: `knowledge_items` (one short item, reference or guidance) and `knowledge_sources` (where distilled items came from).

## Responsibilities
- **`KnowledgeItem` (`knowledge_items`)** has these columns:
  - **identity and classification:** `id`, `kind` (reference|guidance, indexed), `category` (indexed), `concept_id` (nullable, meaning global; indexed);
  - **content:** `title`, `body` (Text), `tags` (JSON text);
  - **targeting:** `audience` (builder|runtime|both, default runtime), `subject` (agent|workflow|both);
  - **guidance-only rules:** `strength` (must|should|may|avoid, guidance only), `conditions` (JSON `[{attr, op, value}]`), `effect` (JSON), `layers` (JSON list of views), `rationale`;
  - **review state:** `status` (proposed|active|retired|conflicting, indexed), `confidence`, `origin` (seed|user|distilled|migrated|ai_drafted);
  - **provenance:** `source_id`, `source_ref` (JSON `{page, quote, document_id, library_id}`), `as_of`;
  - **matching:** `embedding` (JSON floats), `content_hash` (indexed), `legacy_id` (unique);
  - **counters:** `used`, `accepted_builds`, `rolled_back_builds`;
  - **timestamps:** created_at, updated_at.
  - The index `ix_knowledge_kind_status` covers `(kind, status)`.
- **`KnowledgeSource` (`knowledge_sources`)** has `id`, `title`, `source_type` (file|url|text|library_document), `filename`, `url`, `library_id`, `document_id`, `text` (extracted markdown with page markers), `concept_id`, `status` (pending|extracted|distilled|failed), `message`, `item_count`, `version`, `extraction_seconds` and the timestamps.

## Key elements
`KnowledgeItem`, `KnowledgeSource`.
